description: A curated list of tools, frameworks, platforms, and resources for Large Language Model Operations (LLMOps).

title: ezdemo/agent4j
description: Agent4j is a pure-Java AI coding agent framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) with a rich, extensible tool system to create a programming assistant capable of autonomously understanding, writing, and debugging code. Inspired by AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Devin, it is built entirely on Java 17 .

title: MrDoe/OpenCodeRAG
description: OpenCodeRAG is a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) plugin for semantic code search powered by locally-hosted embedding models. It features a seamless integration with OpenCode and offers a CLI interface for external usage.
